method.queryTolerance: Object.is for every numeric field (zero tolerance), recursive object fields
method.raceTolerance: assert.deepStrictEqual on every returned field, including native score, rank, ordered checkpoints, stars, falls, goals, elapsed time, decisions and diagnostics
method.gameRules: Native default v24 physics, same source snapshot, actual base/league stages, full native termination, same frozen adapter inputs. Only track.project query index differs.
method.randomQueries: 300 deterministic on/offroad samples plus30 exact segment endpoints for each of30 stage tracks; includes reversed tracks and native full-scan fallback
method.timing: Per-thread CPU usage (process.threadCpuUsage) and wall time both recorded. Serial native/verify/fast runs in each worker,2 workers by default. CPU ratios avoid shared-load wall-time distortion; constructor/index overhead included.
method.floatingGuard: max(128,32×scannedSegmentCount)×Number.EPSILON×coordinate magnitude; expands the AABB inclusion threshold; scan order and native 1e-4 tie rule are unchanged.
